description: Constituency histories from the second half of Walker's 1801-1922 volume: for each seat, its members from the Union to 1922 with the year each took it and, for contested years, the votes. Civgraph holds nothing comparable -- it records results, not member succession, and nothing before 1885 -- so this is entirely new material and has no second source. UNVERIFIED: treat as a transcription to be spot-checked, not as established data.

provenance.licence: Facts only: names, years, parties and figures. The volume is in copyright, is not in this repository, and its prose is not reproduced beyond the short factual reason a seat fell vacant.
